shaping.title: Unheld, still in Shaping, with the claim released and logged as reclaimed

testing.label: Release {{who}}'s hold

testing.note: No session to reach on this hold: Release lets go of it, and it stays in Testing for the next tester.
testing.done: Released: still in Testing, nobody holds it.

building.label: Release {{who}}'s claim

building.note: No session to reach on this claim: Release puts it back in Ready, its worktree and branch kept.
building.done: Released: back in Ready, its worktree and branch kept.

pane.movedReleased: Put in {{stage}}. {{who}}'s claim on {{from}} was released.

did.blockedTasks: Blocked by those tasks: added to its depends.

sentBack.finding: Sent back to its builder: first in line, with what's wrong as owner finding {{finding}} to fix or dispute.
sentBack.notTold: Its session can't be told ({{why}}); muster next shows it first.

paused.head: Paused: it's in the Paused lane with its stage and claim, and nobody works it until you resume it.
paused.resumed: Resumed: it's back in its column and carries on as it was.
paused.askedStop: Session {{session}} is asked to stop at a safe point after its next tool call.
paused.askedOn: Session {{session}} is asked to carry on after its next tool call.

block.pick: Pick why it's blocked, then say what it waits on.
block.questionAria: The open question it waits on
block.noQuestion: No open question in this task: ask one first, then block on it.
block.depends: They're added to its depends: it shows blocked by them until they're all merged (in Your check or Done; the owner's own, Done), then clears by itself.

editor.unsaved: Unsaved changes: Save, or press Esc twice to discard
editor.unsent: Unsent comment: send it (⌘↩), or press Esc twice to throw it away
editor.saved: Saved. The edit is in the log.

saved.forHuman: It's yours to do now: hatched on the board, with the You ribbon.

next.label: Next step
next.tickFirst: Tick yours in the checklist first
next.holder: {{holder}} holds it in {{stage}}, so only they can pass it on. To move it yourself, click a stage on the track.
next.blocked: {{why}}. Unblock it to pass it on.
next.blockedUnnamed: Blocked on something it doesn't name. Unblock it to pass it on.

next.unknownStage: A stage this window doesn't know: click one on the track.
next.done: Done. Send it back to reopen it.

stage.noOwner: None of the criteria are yours to verify. Accept it, or send it back.

review.notStarted: not started on its own branch
review.heading: Review
review.copied: Copied the review brief. Paste it into a session that didn't build the task to run the next round.
review.notReviewedNote: Not reviewed yet. In Testing a session that didn't build it runs the owner's review engine on the branch ({{cmd}}); the merge waits for a clean review.
review.notStartedNote: Reviewed only when it's started on its own branch ({{cmd}}).
review.gone: Its Review section is gone from the text. Record a new round.

vision.heading: Vision
vision.copied: Copied the vision brief. Paste it into a session to check the task against the picture.
vision.howPlaceholder: How {{id}} was settled, in one line
vision.resolvedNone: Resolved {{id}}. No conflict is open, so it can pass to Ready.
vision.notCheckedNote: Not checked against the project's picture yet. Copy the brief for a session to check it; until it's checked, nothing holds it back.
vision.gone: Its Vision section is gone from the text. Record a new check.

helper.noClaude: Couldn't find the claude command. The helper runs your own Claude Code. Install it, then reopen this tab.
helper.intro: Tell it ideas, bugs and tasks. It files them in {{project}}'s queue, checks for duplicates, and asks when something's unclear.
helper.empty: Nothing yet. Try: “The board flickers when I resize the window, and I'd like a dark mode toggle.”
helper.loginTitle: The account {{account}} isn't logged in on its own.
helper.loginBody: The helper uses an account's own login and never reads tokens, so an account that only works through a shell command with a token won't work here. Pick an account that's logged in, or log this one in (it opens Terminal on Claude's own login).
